Privacy

Privacy policy

We collect as little information as possible, and we look after it the way you would keep a letter someone entrusted to you. Last updated: November 9, 2026.

Person in charge of protecting personal information

Under Québec’s Act respecting the protection of personal information in the private sector (Law 25), the person in charge is [name to confirm], reachable at lapaixducoeur.ca@gmail.com.

What we collect

  • Forms (contact, prayer wall, letters of encouragement, newsletter): only what you choose to write. First name and email are optional on the prayer wall.
  • Donations: handled by our payment platform (Zeffy) or by Interac; we never see your banking details.
  • Visit statistics: cookieless audience measurement (Cloudflare Web Analytics), which does not identify you or follow you across sites. That is why this site shows no cookie banner.

Why

To answer you, carry your requests in prayer, deliver your letters, send you the newsletter if you asked for it, and issue a tax receipt [if registered]. Never to sell or share your information.

Retention and security

Messages are kept as long as needed to handle them, then deleted [period to confirm]. The site is static, with no database or user accounts, and is served over HTTPS.

Photos and children

No photo of an identifiable child is published without the written consent of a parent or guardian. That consent can be withdrawn at any time, and the photo is then removed from the site as quickly as possible.

Your rights

You can ask to access, correct or delete your information, and withdraw your consent, by writing to lapaixducoeur.ca@gmail.com. You may also file a complaint with the Commission d’accès à l’information du Québec.
